summary: Lotwil Veriatus declares the shackles finished and calls on Lucien, Servo and you to bear witness as a powerful elemental is summoned.

sections.title: A Groundbreaking Day
sections.body: Lotwil cries out that the shackles are done and the time has come, calling Lucien and Servo to bear witness along with you. Lotwil presents the shackles as alchemy, engineering and the arcane in perfect combination, and means to summon a powerful elemental on what is declared a groundbreaking day for everyone there.

sections.title: After the Summoning
sections.body: The outcome is not what Lotwil expected, and Lotwil asks you to fetch the Shackles of Elemental Binding back after the Fam'retor Guardian is defeated. Afterwards, Lotwil is unsure what went wrong, but is glad that the magics were at hand to return the creature to the plane it came from.

faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus is the maker of the Shackles of Elemental Binding, in which alchemy, engineering and the arcane are combined. Lucien and Servo are there with Lotwil in the Badlands.

faq.q: What are the Shackles of Elemental Binding?
faq.answer: They are the shackles Lotwil has just finished, a combination of alchemy, engineering and the arcane, for use on a powerful elemental that Lotwil means to summon.

faq.q: Who does Lotwil call to bear witness?
faq.answer: Lotwil calls on Lucien and Servo to bear witness to the summoning, together with you.
It follows the step in which you brought cog #5 to Lotwil.
